extraction_notes: The main article repeatedly refers to Supplementary Tables/Figures containing additional catalyst-performance data (for example Supplementary Tables 3, 4 and 15; Supplementary Figs. 1–5, 33, 60–62 and 74), but those data were not included in the provided full text. Records above are limited to performance values printed in the main article figures/text and readable extended-data plots. Dense/modelled contour maps in Extended Data Fig. 7 are kinetic model predictions, not experimental measurements, and were excluded. Long-term stability and CO/CO2 co-feed performance are mentioned only by reference to Supplementary Figs. 3–4 without readable data here, so no records were extracted for those series.
